in_marathi.name: Krishnakumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Darkness of Krishna, God's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnakumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krishnakumar is a name of two parts – Krishna and Kumar. Krishna signifies the dark form of Vishnu, the preserver in Hinduism, often depicted as the god of love, compassion, and mischief. Kumar translates to young prince or boy, symbolizing the youthful and playful nature of Krishna. Thus, Krishnakumar represents the divine grace and playful nature of Lord Krishna.
